mentions.name: CekYukle
mentions.description: CekYukle is a web app built for a street photographer that lets the people appearing in his photos download their photos when available and give permission for them to be published. It is a multi-user service, and a version without multi-user requirements is available on GitHub.
mentions.problem: Street photographers need a way to let the people in their photos access those photos and obtain their consent before publishing them.
mentions.audience: Street photographers who want to share photos with the people pictured in them
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://cekyukle.com (ie. shoot & upload in Turkish)

I built it for a street photographer friend so he could let people in his photos download their photos when available, and also get their permission to publish them. There is a version without without multi-user requirements under my GH:  https://github.com/hikmet/people-in-photos
